name: Thinking Style
description: How much do you agree with each statement about how you approach problems?
framework: Analytical, creative and practical thinking styles (after Sternberg's triarchic view). All items are original.

items.prompt: Before I decide, I list the pros and cons.
I like to break a big problem into smaller steps.
I check the facts before I believe something I read online.
I usually go with my first instinct instead of thinking it through.
I enjoy finding a new way to do an everyday task.
I often imagine how things could be designed differently.
I like questions that have more than one right answer.
I prefer to stick to methods that have always worked.
I learn best by trying something with my hands.
I like solutions I can use straight away.
I enjoy fixing real problems at home or at school.
I prefer discussing ideas to actually putting them into practice.
